questionText: A contour line joins locations having the same height above the mean sea level. The following is a contour plot of a geographical region. Contour lines are shown at $25\text{ m}$ intervals in this plot. If in a flood, the water level rises to $525\text{ m}$, which of the villages P, Q, R, S, T get submerged?
explanation:
Any village at an elevation of less than $525\text{ m}$ will get submerged when the water level rises to $525\text{ m}$.

Contour Analysis:
1. Village P: Lies inside the $550\text{ m}$ contour ring, so its height is $> 550\text{ m}$. It remains safe.
2. Village Q: Lies in a high-elevation zone $> 525\text{ m}$. It remains safe.
3. Village R: Situated below the $500\text{ m}$ contour line ($< 525\text{ m}$). It gets submerged.
4. Village S: Situated near the $450\text{ m}$ contour line ($< 525\text{ m}$). It gets submerged.
5. Village T: Situated near the $500\text{ m}$ contour line ($< 525\text{ m}$). It gets submerged.

Hence, villages R, S, and T get submerged.
